headline: Greenply Industries expands plywood manufacturing capacity via subsidiary
hook: New manufacturing capacity added in Uttar Pradesh
summary: Greenply Industries has added new manufacturing capacity for plywood and allied products through its wholly-owned subsidiary, Greenply Sandila Private Limited. The facility is located in Sandila, District Hardoi, Uttar Pradesh. This capacity expansion allows the company to scale up its production footprint in the region. For retail investors, production expansions by listed entities signal efforts to drive future revenue growth through higher volume output.
why_it_matters: Higher output potential could drive future revenue growth for Greenply.

headline: Greenply reports 16% revenue growth in Q2 FY27
hook: Revenue and margins climb for Greenply
summary: Greenply Industries posted a consolidated revenue of Rs 799.7 crore for the second quarter of FY27, marking a 16.1% year-on-year increase. Core EBITDA rose by 57.2% to Rs 89.2 crore, with margins reaching 11.2%. The plywood segment saw a 6.1% volume growth, while the MDF business recorded a 16.1% volume increase. MDF margins stood at 15.2% compared to 10.05% in the plywood division.
why_it_matters: Stronger MDF margins signal improved profitability for the company.
